game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Lava Tube Tunnel Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on lava imps.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on lava imps. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the volcanologist ahead. Then check the damage value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving damage that move the volcanologist forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
